compute_dice_loss: compute the Dice Loss for multi-class segmentation with configurable alpha and beta weights for false positives and false negatives
compute_binary_dice_loss: compute the binary Dice Loss for single-class segmentation tasks with optional sigmoid application
compute_multiclass_generalized_dice_loss: compute the multiclass Generalized Dice Loss with automatic class weighting based on inverse squared class frequencies
reduce_loss_values: reduce per-element loss values by mean, sum, or none across specified axes
compute_dice_loss_per_class: compute per-class Dice Loss with class weights, background ignoring, and custom reduction strategy
